title: Oxyrhynchus Osireion Gallery 2E niche 2 — Ficha 343–348 excavated geometry killer-test

verified_sources.author: Maria Teresa Mascort
verified_sources.title: L’Osireion d’Oxirrinc (El Bahnasa, Egipte). Estudi arqueològic i dels rituals del culte a Osiris entre els segles VII aC i II dC
verified_findings: U.E. 15307 is the lower fill of niche 2 in passage/gallery 2E.
The lower fill is described as a 40 cm sand layer containing protective materials of the Osiris simulacrum.
Six limestone boxes with lids and internal mud/slime balls are listed in this context.

Published object descriptions verified in the indexed record state only that each box was located inside niche 2; no individual x/y/z position, compass bearing, face orientation, or box-to-box spatial relation was found in the verified published ficha text.

verified_sources.author: Maria Teresa Mascort
verified_findings: Gallery 2E runs east-west and is parallel to Gallery 1A.
The general ritual interpretation associates magical balls with protection of Osiris from the four cardinal points.
This general ritual/cardinal interpretation does not by itself establish the excavated relative positions of boxes 15307a-f.
O54 / 15305 / Ficha 339 was found in the corridor of Gallery 2E and is excluded from the niche-2 six-box set.

killer_test.question: Does the excavation record preserve the individual in-situ position and/or orientation of boxes 15307a-f inside niche 2, sufficient to test inscription direction against excavated geometry?

individual compass position within the niche
relative arrangement among all six boxes
in-situ photograph or plan tying each labeled box to a position before removal
